topography.project_purpose: Anchor BTC. Structurally: 272 project-authored contract(s) across 10 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 31 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on aave.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 13 functional families. Its contracts share 49 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, oapp, oappsender). Dominant framework: aave.
